selection_rationale: Both lemmas were reviewed as C2A class-only entries before the v11 benchmark family and are already admitted by the generic C2A activation architecture. Stage 1Q authorizes class-level past only for 2pl and 3pl, so 2sg remains an untouched capability gap. The two target lemmas are selected here before any external lookup of their 2sg past surfaces.
notes: This file intentionally contains no target surface answers. Its purpose is to create a Git-verifiable pre-answer checkpoint for a narrow C2A 2sg-past experiment. No 2sg past surface for buuxi or caajisi is asserted here.
